card.name: Ending of the drug name flibanserin
card.fires_on: The final piece "erin" when it completes the drug name flibanserin (flibans+erin) in ADDYI labeling, usually before words like exposure or concentrations.

modes.label: Interaction text
modes.description: Flibanserin exposure or concentrations raised or lowered by CYP3A4 or CYP2C19 inhibitors or inducers.
